thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] reserved-pool 'resv-prod-2' GPU utilization >98% sustained 7m. queue_growth detected. throttles and 503s observed. severity=SEV2. paging oncall.

Maria (SRE): paging @Ryan — can you take initial triage? looks like reserved GPUs filling and autoscaler not spinning up.

Ryan (oncall): on it. pulling metrics now. queue length ~520 pending requests, 4xx/503 spike. LuminaBank tenant accounts for ~60% of the backlog. autoscaler desired=6 current=6 max=6. seems capped.

Ryan (oncall): quick snapshot:
```
pool: resv-prod-2
pending_requests: 523
active_instances: 6
desired_replicas: 6
autoscaler.max_replicas: 6   # configured limit
throttle_events_10m: 247
avg_latency_queue: 2.8s
```

Maria (SRE): nice, so autoscaler is hitting configured max. do we know why max=6? quota or policy?

Jake (Runtime): that's the reserved-pool policy — we set max_replicas to the reservation commit for that pool. looks like someone set a hard cap during the last capacity shuffle. also saw scale-controller errors in logs. past 10m: `scale-controller: reconcile failed: attach GPU: quota_exceeded`

Anya (SRE): hmm, if it's quota we can't just bump without approvals. immediate options: 1) evict best-effort workloads (non-reserved) from resv-prod-2, 2) enable burst routing to 'dedicated-burst-1' for enterprise tenants, 3) throttle LuminaBank at their route (apply soft rate limit) to pace the queue.

Ryan (oncall): starting eviction of BE lanes now. running: `python tools/evict_spot.py --pool resv-prod-2 --priority BE --dry-run=false`

Ryan (oncall): eviction started — freed ~2 nodes but queue only down ~80. LuminaBank still dominating.

Sam (Acct Ops): ping — reaching out to LuminaBank ops and PM now. will tell them we're actively mitigating and expect partial routing to backup in ~10-15m. offering temporary credits if they have production impact.

Noah (Product): confirm whether customer requests are failing (503) or just delayed — product wants wording for status update.

Ryan (oncall): mix. some timeouts resulting in 503 for requests >30s. slower responses for others. example from request logs: `request_id=abc123 tenant=LuminaBank status=504 duration=31.2s`

Jake (Runtime): looking deeper — scale-controller keeps hitting an AWS GPU attach rate limit. i see repeated errors: `ErrAttachVolume: rate exceeded` and an internal reconciler NPE occasionally which delays retries. working on a quick restart of the scale-controller pod to clear transient state.

Maria (SRE): go ahead with restart. also prepare a PR to raise autoscaler.max_replicas for resv-prod-2 to 12, but we'll need post-incident approval for commit-change.

Jake (Runtime): restarting scale-controller now: `kubectl -n infra rollout restart deployment/scale-controller`

incident-bot: SYSTEM: deploy-bot detected restart event in infra/scale-controller by Jake (Runtime).

Ryan (oncall): after restart, autoscaler attempted another reconcile. hitting cloud provider attach quotas still but retries succeeding intermittently. requesting temporary bump of pool max to 12 to allow burst.

Anya (SRE): can we map which tenants are reserved vs best-effort? I can patch routing rules to divert LuminaBank to 'dedicated-backup-1' which has spare capacity. small config change:
```
- routing.rules.resv-prod-2.priority.tenant_lumina = primary
+ routing.rules.resv-prod-2.priority.tenant_lumina = fallback: dedicated-backup-1
```
I'll apply after approval from Maria.

Maria (SRE): do it. prioritize minimizing customer 503s. log the config change in this thread.

Anya (SRE): applying routing patch now. `opsctl routing apply --file tmp/lumina-fallback.yaml`

Anya (SRE): routing change applied. monitoring.

Ryan (oncall): queue dropped from 523 -> 92 within 9 minutes after eviction + routing change + controller restart. throttles dropping. good signal.

Sam (Acct Ops): LuminaBank acknowledged reroute. they reported reduced error rates on their side. they asked for ETA on full capacity fix.

Jake (Runtime): long-term fix: the scale-controller NPE & cloud attach retries need patch. I'll open a ticket. short-term: we increased autoscaler.max_replicas to 12 for resv-prod-2 and requested temporary GPU quota bump from cloud infra team.
